# netbox_virtual_machine_interfaces (Data Source)

Fetches a list of Virtual Machine Interfaces from Netbox.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter by enabled state.
- `name` (String) Filter by interface name.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) Filter by virtual machine ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `virtual_machine_interfaces` (Attributes List) List of virtual machine interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_machine_interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_machine_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_machine_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description for the interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the interface.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the interface.
- `mtu` (Number) The MTU of the interface.
- `name` (String) The name of the interface.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine.
